I felt compelled to speak up after seeing a wave of inaccurate reviews.
I’ve been coming to this PetSmart location for years, and my experience with the floor staff and managers has consistently been excellent. They’ve always been friendly, professional, and helpful, even as staff has come and go.

If you’re here because of the recent video involving the girl and her cat — please understand that PetSmart and Banfield are separate companies, with completely different management. This page is for PetSmart retail, not the Banfield veterinary clinic inside the building.

Leaving 1-star reviews meant for Banfield on this PetSmart page hurts the wrong people and creates confusion. If you want to share feedback about Banfield, make sure it’s on their page, not this one.
DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS HERE

I recently visited this grooming salon for my dog's scheduled appointment with Roberto E., and unfortunately, the experience was far from positive. Upon arrival, Roberto conducted an inspection of my dog's fur and mentioned he would be adding conditioner. I got in my car and after reviewing the charges on my PetSmart app, I noticed that I was being overcharged for both brushing and conditioner fees—something Roberto had never mentioned as additional charges which totaled to be over $50.

I immediately returned to the salon to ask Roberto about the extra charges, and instead of offering a clear explanation, he became defensive, rude, and hostile. I found his attitude unprofessional and uncalled for, so I politely requested my dog back and left the salon.

Things only got worse when I tried to schedule an appointment at the Uptown location where I’ve been a loyal customer for years, only to find that Roberto had flagged my account, preventing me from booking any future grooming sessions.

I went back to the store and spoke with the assistant manager, Ms. Trevino, who took the time to review the situation, sincerely apologized for what had transpired, and removed the flag from my account. While I appreciated her professionalism and effort to resolve the issue, I can’t ignore the fact that the experience with Roberto has completely undermined my trust in this salon.

Given the unprofessional behavior I encountered and the questionable charges, I will not be returning to this location and would caution others to be mindful when dealing with Roberto. I’ve had a much more positive and transparent experience at other locations, and I highly recommend seeking alternatives.
